guide.html: Workbook này dùng kèm handout Lesson 1 (Approach to IELTS Speaking Part 1). Handout dạy lý thuyết và có bài tập ngắn trên lớp; workbook cho bạn luyện thêm với cùng ba kỹ thuật, cùng từ vựng và cùng danh sách câu hỏi.

Unit 1 Phát âm: âm cuối và trọng âm · Unit 2 Ba kỹ thuật: 5W1H, Personalisation, Tense control · Unit 3 Work or studies · Unit 4 Home and accommodation (gồm The area you live in) · Unit 5 Hometown · Phụ lục câu hỏi theo số thứ tự trong handout · Đáp án.
Một câu trả lời Part 1 tốt (handout, KEY IDEA)
Trả lời trực tiếp + 1-2 chi tiết cụ thể (5W1H) + một điều thật về bạn (Personalisation), đúng thì (Tense control). Khoảng 2-4 câu, 30 giây. Ngắn mà tự nhiên tốt hơn dài mà học thuộc.
Lý thuyết: bảng từ vựng của handout kèm ví dụ khi nói (● dễ → ●●● khó), từ vựng bổ sung, bảng Từ câu ngắn đến câu trả lời đầy đủ, câu mẫu, Lỗi cần tránh, Chọn cho đúng, Âm cần luyện.
Bài tập 1: từ vựng → câu nói. Bài tập 2: mở rộng câu trả lời ngắn. Bài tập 3: trả lời câu hỏi trong handout bằng từ vựng và kỹ thuật cho sẵn. Số câu hỏi (Q) giống số trong handout.
Nhìn gợi ý → nói to (không đọc) → viết lại → so với đáp án → nói lại lần hai không nhìn. Đánh dấu ô Nói to ☐ khi đã nói xong. Có thể ghi âm bằng điện thoại hoặc luyện theo cặp.

Đáp án có một câu mẫu và một cách nói khác cũng chấp nhận. Câu của bạn vẫn đúng nếu dùng đủ các cụm gợi ý, giữ đúng ý câu hỏi và không có lỗi. Câu mẫu chỉ để tham khảo: hãy nói về cuộc sống thật của bạn.
● band 5.0-6.0: gợi ý đủ các cụm từ. ●● band 6.0-6.5: ít gợi ý hơn. ●●● band 7.0-7.5: chỉ cho biết cần làm gì.

units.name: Phát âm: âm cuối và trọng âm

theory.html: Người Việt hay nuốt âm cuối vì tiếng Việt không có các cụm phụ âm cuối như -sts, -kts và âm cuối thường không bật hơi. Trong tiếng Anh, âm cuối mang nghĩa ngữ pháp: thiếu /s/ thì parents thành parent (một người), thiếu /d/ thì moved thành move (sai thì). Giám khảo nghe không rõ sẽ khó hiểu ý bạn.
Trọng âm giúp người nghe nhận ra từ. Nói ca-REER thành CA-reer hay com-MU-ni-ty thành COM-mu-ni-ty có thể làm người nghe không hiểu, dù bạn dùng đúng từ.
Unit này dạy quy tắc và cho bạn luyện với chính các từ của ba chủ đề trong handout (Unit 3-5). Phần phát âm cần nói to mới có tác dụng; nếu được, hãy ghi âm và nghe lại, hoặc nhờ giáo viên nghe.

theory.text: Quy tắc trọng âm hay dùng

theory.html: Quy tắc đúng với phần lớn các từ, không phải tất cả. Khi không chắc, hãy tra từ điển: dấu ˈ đứng trước âm tiết được nhấn.

Động từ 2 âm tiết: thường nhấn âm tiết 2
Đuôi -tion, -sion, -ic, -ical, -ity, -ial, -ian: nhấn âm tiết ngay trước đuôi

items: I live with my parents /ts/ in an aPARTment on the twelfth /θ/ floor.
We moved /d/ to Hanoi when I was six, and I've lived /d/ here ever since.
There are lots of shops /s/ and restaurants /ts/ in my NEIGHbourhood.
I'm in grade 11, so I study about ten subjects /kts/, including CHEMistry and LITerature.

items.bad: I live with my parent in a apartment.
items.good: I live with my parents in an apartment.
items.note: Thiếu âm /s/ làm thành một người; trước nguyên âm dùng an.

items.bad: We move here two year ago.
items.good: We moved here two years ago.
items.note: Thiếu /d/ ở moved (sai thì) và /z/ ở years (sai số nhiều).
Sau /t/, đuôi -ed đọc thành một âm tiết riêng /ɪd/.
Nhiều từ giữ trọng âm của từ gốc: CULture → CULtural. Nhưng từ có đuôi -ical thì đổi: HIStory → hisTORical.

items.h: Một chữ, hai cách đọc theo từ loại
items.html: PREsent (danh từ: món quà) · preSENT (động từ: trình bày). Tương tự: REcord / reCORD, INcrease / inCREASE.
crowded /ɪd/ theo quy tắc (từ gốc kết thúc bằng /d/). Một số tính từ đặc biệt luôn đọc /ɪd/ dù không theo quy tắc: naked, wicked.

exercises.title: Bài tập 3: Đọc to câu theo chủ đề
exercises.intro: Với mỗi từ in đậm: (1) gạch chân đuôi -s/-es/-ed và ghi cách đọc /s/, /z/, /ɪz/, /t/, /d/, /ɪd/; (2) khoanh âm tiết được nhấn. Sau đó đọc to cả câu hai lần, đọc rõ mọi âm cuối.

items.cue: I live with my parents in an apartment.
items.answer: I live with my PARents in an aPARTment.
items.note: Âm cuối: parents /ts/. Trọng âm: PArents, aPARTment.

items.cue: My grandparents live in a quiet rural area.
items.answer: My GRANDparents live in a quiet RUral area.
items.note: Âm cuối: grandparents /ts/. Trọng âm: GRANDparents, RUral.

items.answer: We moved to a bigger flat when I was SEVen.
items.note: Âm cuối: moved /d/, flat /t/. Trọng âm: SEven.

items.answer: PUBlic TRANSport in Hanoi is getting better.
items.note: Đọc rõ /t/ cuối transport. Trọng âm: PUBlic, TRANSport (danh từ).

items.answer: My parents are proud of my acaDEMic aCHIEVEments.
items.note: Âm cuối: parents /ts/, achievements /ts/. Trọng âm: acaDEMic, aCHIEVEments.

items.answer: I'm making steady PROgress, but I'm snowed under with homework.
items.note: Âm cuối: snowed /d/. Trọng âm: PROgress (danh từ).

items.answer: My HOMEtown has a FAScinating hisTORical background.
items.note: Trọng âm: HOMEtown, FAScinating, hisTORical, BACKground.

items.answer: The city has underGONE rapid exPANsion, and living STANdards have imPROVED.
items.note: Âm cuối: standards /dz/, improved /d/. Trọng âm: underGONE, exPANsion, STANdards, imPROVED.

items.cue: Street markets encourage social interaction among residents.
items.answer: Street MARkets encourage social interACtion among RESidents.
items.note: Âm cuối: markets /ts/, residents /ts/. Trọng âm: MARkets, interACtion, RESidents.

theory.html: Unit này luyện ba kỹ thuật trong handout: 5W1H, Personalisation và Tense control. Lý thuyết đầy đủ và ví dụ có trong handout (trang 2-4); ở đây chỉ tóm tắt để bạn luyện thêm.
Một câu trả lời Part 1 tốt = trả lời trực tiếp + 1-2 chi tiết cụ thể + một điều thật về bạn, đúng thì. Khoảng 2-4 câu, 20-40 từ (khoảng 30 giây). Ngắn mà tự nhiên tốt hơn dài mà học thuộc.

Câu hỏi trong Unit này lấy từ các chủ đề khác của bản dự đoán (mua sắm, trường cấp 2, công viên, âm nhạc…) để bạn thấy ba kỹ thuật dùng được cho mọi chủ đề, và để không trùng với bài tập trong handout.

cells: Chọn 1-2 yếu tố What, When, Where, Who, Why, How để thêm chi tiết cụ thể, thay vì nói chung chung.
What do you do when you feel tired? → I usually take a nap for about twenty minutes after lunch.
Đưa đặc điểm và hoàn cảnh thật của bạn vào câu trả lời, để không nghe như học thuộc.
Do you often feel tired? → Yes, quite often. I have a super hectic schedule this year.
Nghe tín hiệu trong câu hỏi và dùng đúng thì từ câu đầu tiên.
Did you recycle when you were a kid? → Not really. I didn't think about it back then.

theory.text: Tense control: tín hiệu trong câu hỏi

cells: Did / Was / Were…? · when you were a child · as a kid
Yes, I did. I used to…
Have you ever…? · How long have you…?
Yes, I have. · I've lived here for…
Do you…? · How often…? · What do you usually…?
in the future · Will you…? · Are you looking forward to…?
Would you…? · What would… be like?
I'd love to… · It would be…
Parks used to…, but these days…

items: How often do you eat fruit and vegetables? → Every day, really. I live in an extended family, and my grandma always puts a plate of fruit on the table after dinner. (Personalisation)
Do you prefer to sit by the window when travelling? → Yes, definitely. I like watching the rice fields on long bus trips to my grandparents' village. (5W1H: What + Where)
Have you ever lost things? → Yes, I have. Last year I lost my wallet on the bus, and I never got it back. (Tense control)

items.bad: Do you like shopping? → Yes, I like shopping. I like shopping very much.
items.good: Yes, especially for clothes. I usually go with my best friend at the weekend.
items.note: Lặp lại câu hỏi không thêm ý. Thêm 1-2 chi tiết (5W1H).

items.bad: Did you like going to parks as a child? → Yes, I like it very much.
items.good: Yes, I loved it. My dad took me there every Sunday.
items.note: Câu hỏi quá khứ mà trả lời hiện tại: lỗi Tense control hay gặp nhất.

items.bad: Yes, because music is good for our mental health.
items.good: Yes. I'm preparing for the university entrance exam, so quiet music helps me focus.
items.note: Lý do chung chung ai cũng nói nghe như học thuộc. Dùng một đặc điểm thật của bạn (Personalisation).

items.bad: Một câu trả lời học thuộc dài 80 từ, có Firstly, Secondly, In conclusion.
items.good: 2-4 câu, khoảng 20-40 từ, nói về bản thân bạn.
items.note: Part 1 là hội thoại, không phải bài viết. Từ nối kiểu bài luận làm câu trả lời nghe như đọc thuộc.

items.h: used to / would (thói quen trong quá khứ)
items.html: used to dùng cho cả hành động và trạng thái: I used to live in a tube house. · would chỉ dùng cho hành động lặp lại: Every Sunday, we'd go to the park.

items.h: Have you ever…? → trả lời hai bước
items.html: Câu đầu dùng hiện tại hoàn thành (Yes, I have.), câu kể chi tiết có mốc thời gian dùng quá khứ đơn (Last month I lost…).

exercises.title: Bài tập 1: Chọn câu trả lời tốt nhất
exercises.intro: Đọc câu hỏi và ba câu trả lời. Chọn câu trả lời trực tiếp, đúng thì và có chi tiết. Đọc to câu bạn chọn.

items.q: Do you often feel tired?

options.text: Yes, quite often, especially on Mondays, because I stay up late doing homework.

items.note: B dùng 5W1H (When + Why). A lặp lại câu hỏi; C sai thì và chỉ nói về một ngày.

items.q: How often do you go shopping?

options.text: About once a month, usually with my mum, because she likes to choose my clothes.

items.note: A trả lời đúng how often và thêm Who + Why. B trả lời câu hỏi khác (Do you like…?); C nói về người khác.

items.q: Did you enjoy travelling by car when you were a kid?

options.text: Not really. I always got carsick, so long trips were a nightmare for me.

items.note: C đúng thì quá khứ (Tense control) và có lý do thật. A sai thì; B quá ngắn và sai ngữ pháp.

items.q: Do you wear a watch?

options.text: Not anymore. I used to, but now I just check the time on my phone.

items.note: B so sánh quá khứ và hiện tại bằng used to + now. A quá ngắn; C không trả lời câu hỏi.

items.q: Do you prefer online shopping or in-store shopping?

options.text: Online shopping is online and in-store shopping is in a store.
I'd say in-store shopping, because I like trying clothes on before I buy them.

items.note: C chọn một bên và nêu lý do (Why). A né câu hỏi chọn lựa; B chỉ định nghĩa, không có ý.

items.q: Have you ever returned anything you bought online?

options.text: Yes, I have. Last month I returned a pair of shoes because they were too small.

items.note: A dùng Yes, I have rồi quá khứ đơn cho chi tiết. B và C sai thì.

items.q: What kinds of websites do you often visit?

options.text: Mostly learning websites, like online dictionaries. I use them almost every night for my homework.
I visit websites, many websites, every day.

items.note: B có ví dụ cụ thể (What) và thời gian (When). A chung chung; C lặp từ và không có ý.

items.q: Do you think it is important to wear a watch? Why?

options.text: Yes, it is important because it is important.
Watches were invented a long time ago.
Not really, because most people have phones. Mind you, a watch is handy in exams, when phones aren't allowed.

items.note: C nêu ý chính, lý do và một chi tiết thật về việc đi thi (Personalisation). A lặp ý; B không liên quan.

items.q: Did you prefer to do activities alone or with a group of people when you were a child?

options.text: With a group, definitely. I was always out playing football with the kids in my alley.
I prefer doing things alone now.
Group activities are good for children.

items.note: A đúng thì quá khứ và có kỷ niệm riêng. B nói về hiện tại; C nói chung chung về trẻ em.

items.q: Do you like taking pictures of different views?

options.text: Yes, I like taking pictures of different views.
Yes, especially sunsets. Whenever I travel, I take loads of photos, though I rarely look at them again.
Taking pictures is a popular hobby.

items.note: B có chi tiết (What: sunsets) và thói quen thật của bạn. A lặp câu hỏi; C không nói về bản thân.

exercises.title: Bài tập 2: 5W1H: thêm chi tiết cụ thể
exercises.intro: Câu trả lời ngắn chưa đủ ý. Nói lại câu ngắn, rồi thêm chi tiết bằng gợi ý (mỗi dấu | là một câu mới hoặc một ý mới). Nói to trước, viết sau.

items.q: What do you do when you feel tired?
items.expand: for about twenty minutes / after lunch | help / me / feel fresh
items.answer: I usually take a nap for about twenty minutes after lunch. It helps me feel fresh for my afternoon classes.
items.alt: I usually take a nap after lunch, just for about twenty minutes, because it helps me feel fresh again.
items.note: Thêm thời lượng (for about twenty minutes) và thời điểm (after lunch).

items.q: Do you like shopping?
items.expand: especially / for clothes | usually / go / with / best friend / at the weekend
items.answer: Yes, I do, especially shopping for clothes. I usually go with my best friend at the weekend.
items.alt: Yes, I do, especially for clothes. At the weekend I usually go with my best friend, and we spend hours trying things on.
items.note: Ba chi tiết ngắn (What, Who, When) đủ làm câu trả lời sinh động.

items.q: Do you prefer to sit by the window when travelling?
items.expand: like / watch / rice fields | on / bus trips / to / grandparents' village
items.answer: Yes, definitely. I like watching the rice fields on bus trips to my grandparents' village.
items.alt: Yes, definitely, because I like watching the rice fields go by on bus trips to my grandparents' village.
items.note: Chi tiết What (rice fields) và Where (bus trips to…) thay cho lý do chung the view is nice.

items.q: Where do you usually buy fruit and vegetables?
items.expand: at / local market / near our house | every morning / because / cheaper and fresher
items.answer: My mum usually buys them at a local market near our house. She goes every morning, because it's cheaper and fresher than the supermarket.
items.alt: My mum usually buys them at a local market near our house. She goes there every morning because everything's cheaper and fresher.
items.note: Ba chi tiết Where, When, Why. Nếu thật ra mẹ bạn đi mua, cứ nói thật.

items.q: What do you like to do when visiting a park?
items.expand: usually / in the evening / with my mum | watch / people / dance / play badminton
items.answer: I like walking around, usually in the evening with my mum. We often stop to watch people dance or play badminton.
items.alt: I like walking around, usually in the evening with my mum, and sometimes we watch people dance or play badminton.
items.note: Không cần đủ sáu W; ba chi tiết ngắn là quá đủ.

items.q: What kinds of websites do you often visit?
items.expand: like / online dictionaries | use / them / almost every night / for / homework
items.answer: Mostly learning websites, like online dictionaries. I use them almost every night for my homework.
items.alt: Mostly learning websites. I use them almost every night for homework, like online dictionaries and grammar sites.
items.note: like… đưa ví dụ cụ thể (What) ngay sau câu trả lời ngắn.

items.q: What do you do when you see rubbish on the street?
items.expand: if / near / bin | otherwise / put / in / bag / until / get home
items.answer: I usually pick it up if it's near a bin. Otherwise, I put it in my bag until I get home.
items.alt: If it's near a bin, I usually pick it up. Otherwise, I just put it in my bag until I get home.
items.note: Chi tiết How (cách bạn xử lý) làm câu trả lời thật và cụ thể.

items.q: Have you seen an unforgettable and beautiful view or scenery?
items.expand: last summer / see / sunrise / in Sa Pa | mountains / covered in clouds
items.hint: Kỹ thuật 5W1H (When + Where + What) + Tense control
items.answer: Yes, I have. Last summer I saw the sunrise in Sa Pa. The mountains were covered in clouds, and it looked unreal.
items.alt: Yes, I have. I saw the sunrise in Sa Pa last summer, and I'll never forget how the mountains were covered in clouds.
items.note: Have you seen…? → Yes, I have + quá khứ đơn (saw, were) cho chi tiết.

items.q: How do you remember people's names?
items.short: I try to link the name to something.
items.expand: for example / new classmate / called / Mai | remember / because / my aunt / same name
items.answer: I try to link the name to something. For example, I remember a new classmate called Mai because my aunt has the same name.
items.alt: I try to link the name to something. For example, there's a new classmate called Mai, and I remember her name because my aunt has the same one.
items.note: Ví dụ thật (For example…) cho thấy bạn đang kể, không phải đọc thuộc.

items.q: Is there anything you miss about your secondary school?
items.expand: miss / my old friends / and / long summer holidays | in grade 9 / we / spend / every afternoon / together
items.answer: Yes, quite a few things. I really miss my old friends and the long summer holidays. In grade 9, we spent every afternoon together.
items.alt: Yes, quite a few things. In grade 9 we spent every afternoon together, so I really miss my old friends, and the long summer holidays too.
items.note: Hiện tại (miss) cho cảm xúc bây giờ, quá khứ (spent) cho kỷ niệm.

exercises.title: Bài tập 3: Personalisation: biến câu học thuộc thành câu của bạn
exercises.intro: Câu trả lời nghe như học thuộc. Nói lại câu trả lời, dùng đặc điểm cá nhân cho sẵn để thay lý do chung chung. Sau đó thử nói lại với đặc điểm thật của bạn.

items.q: Do you often feel tired?
items.rote: Yes, because modern life is very stressful.
items.hint: Đặc điểm: lịch học rất dày
items.answer: Yes, quite often. I have a super hectic schedule this year, with school all day and extra classes three evenings a week.
items.alt: Yes, quite often, because I have a super hectic schedule. By Friday evening, I'm completely exhausted.
items.note: Thay lý do chung (modern life is stressful) bằng lịch học thật của bạn.

items.q: How often do you go shopping?
items.rote: Not often, because shopping wastes time and money.
items.hint: Đặc điểm: sống cùng bố mẹ
items.answer: Not very often, actually. I still live with my parents, and my mum buys most of my clothes, so I only go when I need something special.
items.alt: Hardly ever. I live with my parents, and my mum usually buys what I need, so I rarely go shopping on my own.
items.note: Hoàn cảnh thật (mẹ mua đồ cho) giải thích câu trả lời tự nhiên hơn lý do chung.

items.q: How often do you eat fruit and vegetables?
items.rote: Every day, because they are good for our health.
items.hint: Đặc điểm: gia đình nhiều thế hệ
items.answer: Every single day. I live in an extended family, and my grandma always puts a big plate of fruit on the table after dinner.
items.alt: Every day, really. Since I live in an extended family, my grandma makes sure there's fruit after every dinner.
items.note: good for our health là lý do ai cũng nói; chi tiết về bà làm câu trả lời có cá tính.

items.q: Do you listen to music while doing other things?
items.trait: preparing for the university entrance exam
items.hint: Đặc điểm: đang ôn thi đại học
items.answer: Yes, all the time. I'm preparing for the university entrance exam, so I put on some quiet piano music to help me focus while I revise.
items.alt: Yes, a lot. Since I'm preparing for the university entrance exam, I listen to calm music whenever I revise.
items.note: Gắn thói quen nghe nhạc với việc ôn thi thật của bạn.

items.q: Do you like to keep things tidy?
items.rote: Yes, because a tidy room is good for studying.
items.hint: Đặc điểm: ở chung phòng với em
items.answer: I try to, but it's not easy. I share a room with my younger sister, and her stuff always ends up on my desk.
items.alt: I'd like to, but I share a room with my younger sister, so keeping it tidy is almost impossible.
items.note: Một chi tiết hơi buồn cười về em gái làm câu trả lời tự nhiên và dễ nhớ.

items.q: What is your favourite website?
items.rote: My favourite website is YouTube because it is useful and interesting.
items.hint: Đặc điểm: sinh viên năm nhất ngành Luật
items.answer: Probably a legal database my lecturers recommended. As a first-year law student, I use it almost every day to look up cases.
items.alt: As a first-year law student, my favourite is a legal database where I can look up cases. I'm on it almost every day.
items.note: useful and interesting quá chung. Dành cho sinh viên Luật; học sinh cấp 3 có thể nói về một trang học tiếng Anh cụ thể.

items.q: How do you remember people's names?
items.rote: I repeat the name many times because it is a good method.
items.hint: Đặc điểm: rất hay quên tên
items.answer: I have a terrible memory for names, so I save new classmates in my phone with a little note, like "Minh, glasses, sits by the window".
items.alt: Honestly, I have a terrible memory for names, so I write a short note about each new person in my phone.
items.note: Cách làm thật của bạn (ghi chú trong điện thoại) thuyết phục hơn a good method.

items.q: What do you usually do when there is a traffic jam?
items.rote: I stay calm and wait patiently because getting angry is useless.
items.trait: ride an electric bike to school
items.hint: Đặc điểm: đi xe đạp điện đến trường
items.answer: I ride an electric bike to school, so I usually squeeze through the side streets. If that doesn't work, I put on a podcast and accept that I'll be late.
items.alt: Since I ride an electric bike to school, I usually find a way through the small alleys. If not, I just listen to music and wait.
items.note: Phương tiện thật của bạn quyết định bạn làm gì khi kẹt xe; câu trả lời vì thế rất tự nhiên.

items.q: What do you like to do when visiting a park?
items.rote: I like walking and breathing fresh air because it is good for health.
items.hint: Đặc điểm: sống ở chung cư cao tầng
items.answer: Mostly I just walk around and look at the trees. I live in a high-rise flat with no garden, so being surrounded by green space is a real treat for me.
items.alt: I mostly walk around. Because I live in a high-rise flat, I hardly see any trees at home, so the park feels like a treat.
items.note: Hoàn cảnh sống (chung cư, không có vườn) giải thích vì sao bạn thích công viên.

items.q: In what conditions would you use a computer or tablet?
items.rote: I would use a computer for studying and entertainment because it is convenient.
items.trait: preparing for the university entrance exam
items.hint: Đặc điểm: đang ôn thi đại học + giữ would
items.answer: Mostly for revision. Since I'm preparing for the university entrance exam, I'd use my tablet every evening for practice tests, and I'd only play games once I'd finished.
items.alt: Mainly for studying. I'm preparing for the university entrance exam, so I'd use it for practice tests and online lessons most evenings.
items.note: Câu hỏi dùng would nên câu trả lời giữ I'd use. Kết hợp Personalisation và Tense control.

exercises.title: Bài tập 4: Tense control
exercises.intro: Nghe câu hỏi, tìm tín hiệu về thì. Dùng các cụm cho sẵn để nói câu trả lời ngắn đúng thì. Nói to trước, viết sau.

items.q: What was your favourite subject at secondary school?
items.hint: Câu hỏi quá khứ → quá khứ đơn
items.answer: My favourite subject was history.
items.alt: I think my favourite subject was history, because the teacher told great stories.
items.note: What was…? → trả lời bằng was, không dùng is.

items.q: Did you recycle when you were a kid?
items.use: Not really / didn't / think about it
items.answer: Not really. I didn't really think about it when I was a kid.
items.alt: Not really. Back then, I didn't think about it much.
items.note: Phủ định quá khứ: didn't + V (không dùng didn't thought).

items.q: Have you ever lost your keys?
items.use: Yes, I have / lost / last month
items.hint: Have you ever…? → Yes, I have + quá khứ đơn cho chi tiết
items.answer: Yes, I have. I lost them at school last month.
items.alt: Yes, I have. Last month I lost them somewhere at school.
items.note: Có mốc thời gian cụ thể (last month) → quá khứ đơn lost.

items.q: When was the first time you used a computer or tablet?
items.use: first / used / computer / when / I was about six
items.hint: Câu hỏi When was…? → quá khứ đơn
items.answer: I first used a computer when I was about six.
items.alt: I think I first used a computer when I was about six, at my uncle's house.
items.note: first đứng trước động từ: I first used….

items.q: Will you post on social media if you lose your item?
items.hint: Will you… if…? → câu điều kiện loại 1
items.answer: Yes, I probably will, if it's something important.
items.alt: If it's something important, then yes, I probably will.
items.note: Sau if dùng hiện tại đơn (it's), mệnh đề chính dùng will.

items.q: What would your life be like without computers or tablets?
items.use: would be / much harder / especially / studying
items.answer: It would be much harder, especially for studying.
items.alt: Honestly, life would be much harder, especially when it comes to studying.
items.note: Câu hỏi giả định → trả lời bằng would be.

items.q: How are the parks today different from those you visited as a kid?
items.use: when I was a kid / used to / these days
items.hint: So sánh quá khứ và hiện tại
items.answer: When I was a kid, parks used to be quieter, but these days they're busier.
items.alt: Parks used to be quieter when I was a kid, but these days they're always crowded.
items.note: used to cho quá khứ, these days + hiện tại đơn cho bây giờ.

items.q: Are there any differences between the activities you liked when you were a child and those you like now?
items.use: used to / these days / tend to
items.hint: So sánh quá khứ và hiện tại, thêm tend to
items.answer: Yes, quite a lot. I used to love playing outside, but these days I tend to stay in and read.
items.alt: Definitely. I used to spend hours outdoors, whereas these days I tend to stay at home with my books.
items.note: tend to + V (có xu hướng) giúp câu trả lời nghe tự nhiên, bớt tuyệt đối.

items.q: Did you keep your room tidy as a child?
items.use: not at all / my mum / always / had to
items.hint: Câu hỏi quá khứ; dùng had to
items.answer: Not at all. My mum always had to remind me to clean it up.
items.alt: Not at all, to be honest. My mum always had to tell me to tidy it.
items.note: had to là quá khứ của have to.

items.q: Will you buy an expensive car in the future?
items.use: I doubt it / I'd rather / spend / money on
items.hint: Câu hỏi tương lai: I doubt it + I'd rather
items.answer: I doubt it. I'd rather spend my money on travelling.
items.alt: Honestly, I doubt it. I'd rather spend money on things like travelling or education.
items.note: I'd rather + V nguyên mẫu = tôi thích … hơn.

theory.html: Unit này luyện từ vựng và cách diễn đạt trong handout (mục 1.1 và 1.2) với hoàn cảnh của học sinh cấp 3. Các câu dành riêng cho sinh viên Luật được ghi rõ trong gợi ý. Số câu hỏi (Q1-Q20) khớp với danh sách trong handout.
Nếu bạn chưa đi làm mà gặp câu hỏi Q12-Q20, hãy nói thật (I'm still a student, so I don't work yet) rồi chuyển sang việc học hoặc công việc mơ ước.

theory.text: Từ vựng hay cho chủ đề

cells: My parents put my academic achievements on the fridge.
I'm under a lot of pressure this year because of exams.
I'm making steady progress with my speaking.
Before exams, I'm snowed under with homework.
Lack of sleep really affects my academic performance.
I'm still trying to get the hang of essay writing.
I hope to go into higher education in Hanoi.
My school has a really supportive learning environment.
When three tests fall on one day, I can get a bit overwhelmed.
My English has come a long way since grade 10.
I want a deep understanding of how the law works.
During project weeks, we're up against tight deadlines.
My dad believes in lifelong learning; he's learning Korean at 50.

theory.text: Từ câu ngắn đến câu trả lời đầy đủ

theory.html: Công thức (giống handout): trả lời trực tiếp + 1-2 chi tiết cụ thể (5W1H) + một điều thật về bạn (Personalisation), đúng thì (Tense control). Chỉ cần 2-4 câu.

head: Câu hỏi + câu trả lời ngắn
Kỹ thuật
Câu trả lời mở rộng

cells: Q8 How much time do you spend on your studies each week? → A lot.
Quite a lot, actually. I'm snowed under with homework this year, and I take extra classes three evenings a week.
Q10 What technology do you use when you study? → My laptop.
I mostly use my laptop. I look up new words in an online dictionary every night, for about an hour.
Q12 What work do you do? → I don't work.
I don't work yet, because I'm still a student. Right now I'm working towards a good score in the university entrance exam.

items: Q7 Do you prefer to study in the mornings or in the afternoons? → Definitely the mornings. My mind's much fresher then, whereas in the afternoons I often feel sleepy after lunch.
Q4 Do you have any plans for your studies in the next five years? → Yes, I do. I'm hoping to go into higher education in law, and then maybe do a master's degree abroad.
Q2 Why did you choose to study that subject? (sinh viên Luật) → I chose law because I wanted a deep understanding of how society works, and it's challenging but rewarding.

items.note: Không nói student grade 11. Dùng I'm in grade 11 hoặc I'm a grade 11 student.

items.bad: I do steady progress every week.
items.good: I'm making steady progress every week.
items.note: Kết hợp từ đúng là make progress (handout: I'm making steady progress).
Cụm cố định snowed under with, không bỏ under.

items.html: study (học một môn, ôn bài): I'm studying for my exams. · learn (học được, biết thêm): I learned a lot from that teacher.

items.h: Cụm trong handout viết cho người đi làm → đổi sang việc học
items.html: snowed under with work → with homework · up against tight deadlines (internship) → during project weeks · working towards a promotion → a band 6.5 / a place at university.

lines: Cụm phụ âm cuối: subjects /kts/ · achievements /nts/ · deadlines /nz/
theory.tip: Nói to từng từ ba lần, rồi nói lại cả câu mẫu có chứa từ đó.

exercises.title: Bài tập 1: Từ vựng chủ đề → câu nói
exercises.intro: Nhìn gợi ý, nói to câu hoàn chỉnh (không đọc), rồi viết lại. Mỗi câu có một cụm từ vựng của chủ đề; hãy dùng đúng cụm đó.

items.cue: my parents / proud of / my academic achievements
items.answer: My parents are really proud of my academic achievements.
items.alt: My parents are proud of my academic achievements, especially in maths.
items.note: be proud of + danh từ; achievements thường ở số nhiều.

items.cue: I / under a lot of pressure / this year
items.answer: I'm under a lot of pressure this year.
items.alt: This year I'm under a lot of pressure because of the exams.
items.note: be under pressure; có thể thêm lý do bằng because of.

items.cue: I / make steady progress / with / my English
items.answer: I'm making steady progress with my English.
items.alt: Thanks to my teacher, I'm making steady progress with my English.
items.note: make progress (không dùng do progress); hiện tại tiếp diễn cho quá trình đang diễn ra.

items.cue: I / snowed under with / homework / before exams
items.answer: I'm snowed under with homework before exams.
items.alt: Before exams, I'm always snowed under with homework.
items.note: Handout dùng with work; với học sinh, đổi thành with homework.

items.cue: lack of sleep / really affect / my academic performance
items.answer: Lack of sleep really affects my academic performance.
items.alt: Honestly, lack of sleep really affects my academic performance, especially in maths.
items.note: lack of sleep là danh từ số ít → affects.

items.cue: I / still / try / get the hang of / essay writing
items.answer: I'm still trying to get the hang of essay writing.
items.alt: To be honest, I'm still trying to get the hang of essay writing.
items.note: get the hang of + danh từ hoặc V-ing.

items.cue: I / work towards / band 6.5 / in IELTS
items.hint: Hiện tại tiếp diễn; mạo từ a
items.answer: I'm working towards a band 6.5 in IELTS.
items.alt: At the moment I'm working towards a band 6.5 in IELTS.
items.note: Handout: working towards a promotion; với học sinh, đổi thành mục tiêu học tập.

items.cue: Say how your English has changed since grade 10. Use "come a long way".
items.hint: Hiện tại hoàn thành + so sánh với trước kia
items.answer: I've come a long way since grade 10. Back then I could hardly speak, but now I can chat with my teacher in English.
items.alt: My English has come a long way since grade 10. I used to freeze when I spoke, but now I feel much more confident.
items.note: have come a long way since + mốc thời gian (hiện tại hoàn thành).

items.cue: Say what you plan to do after high school. Use "higher education".
items.answer: I'm planning to go into higher education, hopefully studying law at a university in Hanoi.
items.alt: After high school, I'm hoping to go into higher education, probably in economics.
items.note: go into / pursue higher education: I'm planning to / I'm hoping to cho kế hoạch.

items.cue: Describe your school. Use "learning environment" and "critical thinking".
items.hint: Hai câu: nhận xét + chi tiết
items.answer: My school has a really supportive learning environment. The teachers encourage critical thinking, so we're always asked to explain our opinions.
items.alt: The learning environment at my school is quite competitive, but our teachers do encourage critical thinking in class discussions.
items.note: Câu đầu nhận xét, câu sau thêm chi tiết (5W1H: Who + How).

exercises.title: Bài tập 2: Mở rộng câu trả lời
exercises.intro: Câu trả lời ngắn chưa đủ ý. Nói lại câu ngắn, rồi mở rộng thêm 1-2 câu bằng gợi ý (mỗi dấu | là một câu mới hoặc một ý mới). Nói to trước, viết sau.

items.q: What subjects are you studying?
items.expand: at the moment / spend / most of my time / on / maths and English | because / need / them / for / university entrance exam
items.answer: I'm studying lots of subjects, but at the moment I spend most of my time on maths and English, because I need them for the university entrance exam.
items.alt: Lots of subjects. At the moment, I spend most of my time on maths and English, mainly because I need them for the university entrance exam.
items.note: Nêu cụ thể môn nào (What) và vì sao (Why) thay vì chỉ nói lots of subjects.

items.q: Do you prefer to study in the mornings or in the afternoons?
items.expand: because / mind / fresher | in the afternoons / often / feel sleepy
items.answer: I prefer the mornings, because my mind is much fresher. In the afternoons, I often feel sleepy after lunch.
items.alt: I prefer studying in the mornings because my mind feels fresher then. In the afternoons I often feel a bit sleepy.
items.note: Câu hỏi chọn lựa: chọn một bên, rồi so sánh với bên còn lại.

items.q: What technology do you use when you study?
items.expand: look up / new words / online dictionary | every night / for about an hour
items.answer: I mostly use my laptop. I look up new words in an online dictionary every night, usually for about an hour.
items.alt: I mostly use my laptop. Every night, for about an hour, I look up new words in an online dictionary.
items.note: Thêm When (every night) và How long (for about an hour).

items.q: How much time do you spend on your studies each week?
items.expand: snowed under with / homework | apart from / school / take extra classes / three evenings a week
items.answer: Quite a lot, actually. I'm snowed under with homework this year, and apart from school, I take extra classes three evenings a week.
items.alt: Quite a lot, actually. Apart from school, I take extra classes three evenings a week, so I'm always snowed under with homework.
items.note: Lịch học thật của bạn (học thêm ba tối) trả lời đúng how much time.

items.q: Do you have any plans for your studies in the next five years?
items.expand: hoping to / go into / higher education / in law | then / maybe / do / master's degree / abroad
items.hint: Kỹ thuật Tense control (kế hoạch tương lai)
items.answer: Yes, I do. I'm hoping to go into higher education in law, and then maybe do a master's degree abroad.
items.alt: Yes, I do. First I'm hoping to go into higher education in law, and then I'd maybe like to do a master's degree abroad.
items.note: Câu hỏi về the next five years → I'm hoping to / I'd like to.

items.q: What changes would you like to see in your school?
items.short: I'd like to see more practical lessons.
items.expand: at the moment / most lessons / exam-focused | so / no time / for / critical thinking
items.answer: I'd like to see more practical lessons. At the moment, most lessons are very exam-focused, so there's no time for critical thinking.
items.alt: I'd like to see more practical lessons. Most lessons at the moment are really exam-focused, so there's almost no time for critical thinking.
items.note: Nêu tình trạng hiện tại để giải thích vì sao bạn muốn thay đổi.

items.q: Are you looking forward to working?
items.expand: can't wait / earn / my own money | although / bit nervous / about / pressure
items.answer: Yes, definitely. I can't wait to earn my own money, although I'm a bit nervous about the pressure of a full-time job.
items.alt: Yes, definitely. I really can't wait to earn my own money, although I'm a bit nervous about the pressure, to be honest.
items.note: can't wait to + V (rất mong); although thêm cảm xúc thật.

items.q: Why did you choose to study that subject?
items.short: I chose law mainly because of my dad.
items.expand: he / lawyer / always / say / job / challenging but rewarding
items.hint: Kỹ thuật Personalisation (dành cho sinh viên Luật)
items.answer: I chose law mainly because of my dad. He's a lawyer, and he always says his job is challenging but rewarding.
items.alt: I chose law mainly because of my dad, who's a lawyer. He always says his job is challenging but rewarding, and that made me curious.
items.note: Câu hỏi quá khứ (did you choose) → I chose. Học sinh cấp 3 có thể nói về ngành dự định học.

items.q: What are the benefits of being your age?
items.short: I'd say the biggest benefit is having few responsibilities.
items.expand: my parents / still / take care of / bills | can / focus on / studying | although / under a lot of pressure
items.answer: I'd say the biggest benefit is having few responsibilities. My parents still take care of the bills, so I can focus on studying, although I'm under a lot of pressure from exams.
items.alt: The biggest benefit is having few responsibilities, I'd say. My parents still take care of the bills, which means I can focus on studying, although I'm under a lot of pressure.
items.note: Lợi ích → lý do thật → một ý ngược lại: đủ dài nhưng vẫn gọn.

items.q: What do you think is the most important at the moment?
items.short: For me, it's definitely the university entrance exam.
items.expand: next summer | working towards / place / at / good university | so / every hour / count
items.answer: For me, it's definitely the university entrance exam next summer. I'm working towards a place at a good university, so every hour counts right now.
items.alt: Without a doubt, the university entrance exam next summer. I'm working towards a place at a good university, so I feel like every hour counts.
items.note: Hiện tại tiếp diễn (I'm working towards) cho mục tiêu đang theo đuổi.

exercises.title: Bài tập 3: Trả lời câu hỏi trong handout
exercises.intro: Trả lời bằng 2-4 câu (khoảng 20-40 từ). Số câu hỏi (Q) khớp với danh sách câu hỏi trong handout. Dùng cụm từ vựng cho sẵn và kỹ thuật ở dòng gợi ý. Câu mẫu trong đáp án chỉ để tham khảo; hãy nói về cuộc sống thật của bạn.

items.q: What subjects are you studying?
items.answer: I'm in grade 11, so I study about ten subjects. I'm doing well in maths, and I'm making steady progress in English, but literature is still a real struggle.

items.q: Do you think that your subject is popular in your country?
items.answer: Yes, English is really popular in Vietnam. Lots of students learn it because they want to go into higher education abroad one day.

items.q: How much time do you spend on your studies each week?
items.answer: Probably around forty hours a week. I'm under a lot of pressure this year, so besides school, I also take extra classes and study at weekends.

items.q: What changes would you like to see in your school?
items.answer: I'd love a more relaxed learning environment. There's too much focus on tests at my school, so students are always stressed.

items.q: What are the benefits of being your age?
items.answer: I think young people pick things up quickly. For example, I got the hang of video editing in just a week, while my dad is still struggling with it.

items.q: What work do you do?
items.hint: Kỹ thuật Personalisation (khi chưa đi làm)
items.answer: I don't work yet, because I'm still a student. Right now I'm working towards a good score in the university entrance exam, which feels like a full-time job.

items.q: Do you miss being a student?
items.hint: Kỹ thuật Tense control (khi chưa đi làm)
items.answer: I'm still a student, so not yet! But I'm sure I'll miss my classmates one day, because we've been through so much together.

items.q: Why did you choose to study that subject?
items.hint: Kỹ thuật Personalisation + Tense control (dành cho sinh viên Luật)
items.answer: I chose law because I wanted a deep understanding of how society works. I was in the debate club in high school, and my teachers kept saying I'd make a good lawyer.

items.q: Do you want to change your major?
items.hint: Kỹ thuật Tense control (dành cho sinh viên Luật)
items.answer: Not really. Law is challenging but rewarding, and I've enjoyed it much more since I did an internship last summer.

items.q: Do you have any plans for your studies in the next five years?
items.hint: Kỹ thuật Tense control (kế hoạch tương lai)
items.answer: Yes, I'm hoping to finish a law degree and maybe start a master's. Honestly, though, I believe in lifelong learning, so I'll probably keep taking short courses after that.

theory.html: Unit này luyện 12 cụm từ trong handout (mục 2.1) cho câu hỏi Q1-Q23, gồm cả phần The area you live in (Q17-Q23). Phần lớn các bạn sống cùng bố mẹ ở thành phố lớn, nên câu mẫu nói về căn hộ chung cư hoặc nhà ống.

Nhiều cụm trong handout khá trang trọng (immediate environment, close proximity, basic function, living standard). Dùng một cụm trong một câu trả lời là đủ; dồn nhiều cụm trang trọng vào một câu sẽ nghe như học thuộc. Cột ví dụ dưới đây cho cách dùng tự nhiên khi nói.

theory.text: Từ vựng hay cho chủ đề

cells: Having my own room gives me some personal space.
The living conditions in our flat are pretty good, apart from the heat in summer.
There's a strong local community spirit in our alley.
There isn't much social interaction in my building; people are always busy.
When my grandma moved in, we all had to make some adjustments.
We had to make arrangements for my grandma's room before she moved in.
Living with three generations gives us lots of shared experiences.
Our flat is ideally suited to a small family like mine.
We live in close proximity to my school. (Khi nói, close to tự nhiên hơn.)
My family's living standards have gone up since my parents opened a shop.
I like a clean immediate environment, so I tidy the corridor outside our door.
For me, the basic function of a home is somewhere safe to rest.

theory.text: Từ vựng bổ sung để tả nhà của bạn

theory.html: Không có trong handout, nhưng cần để mô tả nhà ở thành phố lớn.

cells: I live with my parents and my younger brother.
căn hộ chung cư cao tầng
We live in a high-rise flat on the twelfth floor.
My grandparents still live in a narrow tube house.
Our living room is a bit cramped, but really cosy.
My mum gets on well with the neighbours.

theory.text: Từ câu ngắn đến câu trả lời đầy đủ

theory.html: Công thức (giống handout): trả lời trực tiếp + 1-2 chi tiết cụ thể (5W1H) + một điều thật về bạn (Personalisation), đúng thì (Tense control). Chỉ cần 2-4 câu.

head: Câu hỏi + câu trả lời ngắn
Kỹ thuật
Câu trả lời mở rộng

cells: Q1 Who do you live with? → My parents.
I live with my parents and my younger sister. We get on really well, although we argue about the TV sometimes.
Q17 Do you live in a noisy or a quiet area? → Noisy.
It's quite noisy, because we live next to a main road. The traffic starts at around 6 a.m.
Q15 How long have you lived there? → Ten years.
About ten years now. We moved there when I was in grade 1, so it's the only home I really remember.

items: Q10 Can you describe the place where you live? → It's a three-bedroom flat on the twelfth floor. The living conditions are pretty good: it's bright and quiet, and from the balcony we can see a big part of the city.

Q4 What's the difference between where you are living now and where you have lived in the past? → When I was little, we lived in a tube house that was a bit cramped. Now we live in a flat, which is much brighter.
Q18 Are the people in your neighbourhood nice and friendly? → Yes, most of them are. There's a strong local community spirit, and people often chat outside in the evenings.

items.note: Bố và mẹ là hai người → parents (đọc rõ âm cuối /ts/).

items.good: My apartment is on the twelfth floor.
items.note: Tầng: dùng on the + số thứ tự + floor.

items.bad: I reside in a serene immediate environment in close proximity to my school, ideally suited to my living conditions.
items.good: It's a quiet area, and my school is close by, so it suits me perfectly.
items.note: Dồn nhiều cụm trang trọng vào một câu nghe như học thuộc. Chọn một cụm, phần còn lại nói đơn giản.

items.h: living standard / living standards / standard of living
items.html: Khi nói về mức sống, người bản xứ thường dùng living standards (số nhiều) hoặc standard of living: Living standards have improved.
in close proximity to đúng nhưng trang trọng. Khi nói, close to / near / within walking distance of tự nhiên hơn.

lines: Phụ âm cuối (đọc rõ, không nuốt): flat /t/ · local · personal
theory.tip: Nói to từng từ ba lần, rồi nói lại cả câu mẫu có chứa từ đó.

exercises.title: Bài tập 1: Từ vựng chủ đề → câu nói
exercises.intro: Nhìn gợi ý, nói to câu hoàn chỉnh (không đọc), rồi viết lại. Mỗi câu có một cụm từ vựng của chủ đề; hãy dùng đúng cụm đó.

items.cue: I / live with my parents / and / younger brother / high-rise flat
items.answer: I live with my parents and my younger brother in a high-rise flat.
items.alt: At the moment I live with my parents and my younger brother in a high-rise flat in Hanoi.
items.note: live with + người; in a high-rise flat.

items.cue: having / my own room / give / me / personal space
items.hint: Danh động từ làm chủ ngữ → gives
items.answer: Having my own room gives me some personal space.
items.alt: Having my own room gives me the personal space I need to study.
items.note: Having… làm chủ ngữ số ít → gives.

items.cue: living conditions / in our flat / pretty good
items.answer: The living conditions in our flat are pretty good.
items.alt: Overall, the living conditions in our flat are pretty good, apart from the heat in summer.
items.note: living conditions luôn ở số nhiều → are.

items.cue: there / not / much / social interaction / in my building
items.answer: There isn't much social interaction in my building.
items.alt: To be honest, there isn't much social interaction in my building.
items.note: social interaction không đếm được → much.

items.cue: our flat / ideally suited to / small family / like mine
items.answer: Our flat is ideally suited to a small family like mine.
items.alt: I'd say our flat is ideally suited to a small family like mine.
items.note: be ideally suited to + danh từ.

items.cue: when / my grandma / move in / we / all / make adjustments
items.answer: When my grandma moved in, we all had to make some adjustments.
items.alt: We all had to make adjustments when my grandma moved in with us.
items.note: Kể chuyện đã xảy ra → quá khứ đơn moved, had to.

items.cue: we / live / close proximity to / my school
items.answer: We live in close proximity to my school.
items.alt: Luckily, we live in close proximity to my school, so I can walk there.
items.note: Cụm cố định in close proximity to. Khi nói thường ngày, close to tự nhiên hơn.

items.cue: Say what a home is for. Use "basic function".
items.hint: Một câu nêu quan điểm của bạn
items.answer: For me, the basic function of a home is to give you somewhere safe to rest after a long day.
items.alt: I think the basic function of a home is simple: it's where you can relax and be yourself.
items.note: Mở đầu bằng For me / I think để câu nghe như ý kiến riêng, bớt trang trọng.

items.cue: Say how your family's life has changed. Use "living standards".
items.answer: My family's living standards have improved a lot since my parents opened their own business.
items.alt: Our living standards have gone up a lot since my parents opened a small shop.
items.note: Dùng số nhiều living standards; since + mốc → hiện tại hoàn thành.

items.cue: Describe living with your family. Use "shared experiences".
items.hint: Thêm một ví dụ cụ thể
items.answer: Living with three generations under one roof gives us lots of shared experiences, like making spring rolls together before Tet.
items.alt: We have lots of shared experiences because we all live together, like cooking for Tet every year.
items.note: Ví dụ cụ thể (like making spring rolls) giúp cụm trang trọng nghe tự nhiên.

exercises.title: Bài tập 2: Mở rộng câu trả lời
exercises.intro: Câu trả lời ngắn chưa đủ ý. Nói lại câu ngắn, rồi mở rộng thêm 1-2 câu bằng gợi ý (mỗi dấu | là một câu mới hoặc một ý mới). Nói to trước, viết sau.

items.q: Who do you live with?
items.expand: and / younger sister | we / get on / really well
items.answer: I live with my parents and my younger sister. We get on really well, although we argue about the TV sometimes.
items.alt: I live with my parents and my younger sister, and luckily we all get on really well.
items.note: get on well = hòa thuận. although… thêm một chi tiết thật.

items.q: Do you live in an apartment or a house?
items.expand: on the twelfth floor / high-rise building | view / of the city / amazing at night
items.answer: I live in an apartment on the twelfth floor of a high-rise building. The view of the city is amazing at night.
items.alt: I live in an apartment on the twelfth floor of a high-rise building, and at night the view of the city is amazing.
items.note: Thêm vị trí (tầng mấy) và một điều bạn thích (view).

items.q: What part of your home do you like the most?
items.short: I like my bedroom the most.
items.expand: because / it / have / big window | so / it / get / lot of / natural light
items.answer: I like my bedroom the most because it has a big window, so it gets a lot of natural light.
items.alt: I like my bedroom the most, mainly because it has a big window, so it gets a lot of natural light all day.
items.note: because nêu lý do, so nêu kết quả.

items.q: What room does your family spend most of the time in?
items.expand: every evening / we / watch TV / together | it / a bit cramped / but / cosy
items.answer: Definitely the living room. Every evening we watch TV together there. It's a bit cramped, but it's really cosy.
items.alt: Definitely the living room. Every evening we watch TV together there, and honestly, it's a bit cramped, but it feels really cosy.
items.note: Chi tiết When (every evening) và What (watch TV).

items.q: What do you usually do in your apartment?
items.short: Mostly I study in my room.
items.expand: since / preparing for / university entrance exam | at weekends / help / my mum / cook
items.answer: Mostly I study in my room, since I'm preparing for the university entrance exam. At weekends, though, I help my mum cook.
items.alt: Mostly I study in my room. Since I'm preparing for the university entrance exam, I don't have much choice, but at weekends I help my mum cook.
items.note: Đặc điểm thật (đang ôn thi) giải thích vì sao bạn chủ yếu học ở nhà.

items.q: How long have you lived there?
items.expand: we / move / there / when / I / be / in grade 1
items.answer: About ten years now. We moved there when I was in grade 1, so it's basically the only home I remember.
items.alt: About ten years now. We moved there when I was in grade 1, and I've lived there ever since.
items.note: Mốc chuyển nhà ở quá khứ (moved, was); khoảng thời gian đến nay dùng I've lived.

items.q: Do you plan to live there for a long time?
items.expand: after / university / like / rent / flat / of my own | because / want / more personal space
items.hint: Kỹ thuật Tense control (kế hoạch tương lai)
items.answer: Probably not forever. After university, I'd like to rent a flat of my own, because I want more personal space.
items.alt: Probably not forever. I'd like to rent a flat of my own after university, mainly because I want more personal space.
items.note: a flat of my own = căn hộ riêng; I'd like to cho kế hoạch.

items.q: Do you think it is important to live in a comfortable environment?
items.short: Yes, I think it's really important.
items.expand: because / living conditions / affect / mood | for example / when / room / messy / can't / focus
items.answer: Yes, I think it's really important, because our living conditions affect our mood. For example, when my room is messy, I just can't focus.
items.alt: Yes, I think it's really important, because living conditions affect your mood. For example, I can't focus at all when my room is messy.
items.note: Ý chung + ví dụ của bản thân.

items.q: Do you live in a noisy or a quiet area?
items.expand: because / live / next to / main road | traffic / start / at around 6 a.m.
items.answer: It's quite noisy, because we live next to a main road. The traffic starts at around 6 a.m.
items.alt: It's quite noisy because we live next to a main road, and the traffic starts at around 6 a.m. every day.
items.note: Lý do (Why) và thời gian (When) chứng minh noisy. So sánh với câu mẫu trong handout: câu này đơn giản hơn nhưng vẫn đủ ý.

items.q: What are some changes in the area recently?
items.expand: new shopping mall / open | so / traffic / get / much worse
items.hint: Kỹ thuật Tense control (hiện tại hoàn thành)
items.answer: Quite a lot has changed. A new shopping mall has opened nearby, so the traffic has got much worse.
items.alt: Quite a lot has changed, mainly because a new shopping mall has opened next door, and so the traffic has got much worse at rush hour.
items.note: Thay đổi gần đây → hiện tại hoàn thành (has opened, has got worse).

exercises.title: Bài tập 3: Trả lời câu hỏi trong handout
exercises.intro: Trả lời bằng 2-4 câu (khoảng 20-40 từ). Số câu hỏi (Q) khớp với danh sách câu hỏi trong handout. Dùng cụm từ vựng cho sẵn và kỹ thuật ở dòng gợi ý. Câu mẫu trong đáp án chỉ để tham khảo; hãy nói về cuộc sống thật của bạn.

items.q: What's the difference between where you are living now and where you have lived in the past?
items.hint: Kỹ thuật Tense control (quá khứ + hiện tại)
items.answer: When I was little, we lived in a tube house that was a bit cramped. Now we live in a flat, which is much brighter, though we had to make a few adjustments, like getting used to the lift.

items.q: What kind of house or apartment do you want to live in in the future?
items.hint: Kỹ thuật Tense control (would, tương lai)
items.answer: I'd love a small house with a garden, somewhere ideally suited to someone who loves plants, like me. I'd also want a big kitchen, because I enjoy cooking.

items.q: What kinds of accommodation do you live in?
items.answer: I live in a high-rise flat in Cau Giay district. It's in close proximity to my school and a big supermarket, which is really convenient.

items.q: Can you describe the place where you live?
items.answer: Sure. It's a three-bedroom flat on the twelfth floor. The living conditions are pretty good: it's bright and quiet, and from the balcony we can see a big part of the city.

items.q: Please describe the room you live in.
items.answer: It's quite small, with a bed, a desk and a huge pile of exam books. But it's my own personal space, so I can study without being disturbed.

items.q: What's your favourite room in your apartment or house?
items.answer: My favourite room is the kitchen, believe it or not. My grandma and I cook there every Sunday, so it's full of shared experiences.

items.q: What makes you feel pleasant in your home?
items.answer: Mainly the people. I live in an extended family, so there's always someone to chat with when I get home from school.

items.q: Do you like the area that you live in?
items.answer: Yes, I do. There's a strong local community spirit, and everything I need, like shops and a market, is just a short walk away.

items.q: Where do you like to go in that area?
items.answer: Usually the small park near my building. There's lots of social interaction there in the evenings, with people dancing, playing badminton and chatting.

items.q: Do you know any of your neighbours?
items.answer: Yes, a few of them. My mum gets on well with the family next door, so we often swap food during Tet.

theory.html: Unit này luyện 12 cụm từ trong handout (mục 3.1) cho câu hỏi Q1-Q13. Câu mẫu nói về Hà Nội vì phần lớn các bạn sinh ra và lớn lên ở đây; nếu quê bạn ở nơi khác, giữ cấu trúc và thay thông tin.

Như handout đã lưu ý (TENSE TRAP), chủ đề này trộn nhiều thì: Q1 (Have you learned…?) hiện tại hoàn thành, Q2 và Q11 (Did you learn…?) quá khứ đơn, Q7 (How long have you been living…?) hiện tại hoàn thành.

theory.text: Từ vựng hay cho chủ đề

cells: I grew up in a busy urban area, right in the centre of Hanoi.
My grandparents live in a quiet rural area outside the city.
Public transport is getting better, especially the metro.
As a kid, I learned a lot about the local culture from my grandparents.
The local community in my alley organises a party every Mid-Autumn Festival.
I'm proud of the city's cultural heritage, like the Temple of Literature.
The natural environment could be better, mainly because of air pollution.
Street food stalls create lots of social interaction between neighbours.
Hanoi has a rich historical background; it's over a thousand years old.
The city has seen rapid expansion, with new districts everywhere.
Living standards have improved a lot since my parents were young.
Its geographical location on the Red River helped it grow into a big city.

cells: sinh ra và lớn lên ở
I was born and raised in Hanoi.

kẹt xe / ô nhiễm không khí

theory.html: Công thức (giống handout): trả lời trực tiếp + 1-2 chi tiết cụ thể (5W1H) + một điều thật về bạn (Personalisation), đúng thì (Tense control). Chỉ cần 2-4 câu.

head: Câu hỏi + câu trả lời ngắn
Kỹ thuật
Câu trả lời mở rộng

cells: Q3 Is that a big city or a small place? → A big city.
It's a really big city. It's the capital, and over eight million people live there.
Q4 Do you like your hometown? → Yes.
Yes, I do. I'm proud of its cultural heritage, and all my childhood memories are here.
Q2 Did you learn about the culture of your hometown in your childhood? → Yes.
Yes, I did. Every Mid-Autumn Festival, my grandparents took me to Hang Ma Street to see the lanterns.

items: Q9 Please describe your hometown a little. → Sure. Hanoi is the capital of Vietnam. It's a mix of old and new: narrow streets in the Old Quarter and modern skyscrapers in the newer districts.
Q7 How long have you been living there? → My whole life. I've lived here since I was born, and I've never lived anywhere else.
Q13 Is your hometown a good place for young people to pursue their careers? → Yes, I'd say so. There are lots of job opportunities. The only problem is the cost of living, which is pretty high.

items.note: Kết hợp từ đúng là famous for hoặc known for.

items.bad: I live in Hanoi since I was born.
items.good: I've lived in Hanoi since I was born.
items.note: since + mốc thời gian → hiện tại hoàn thành I've lived (hoặc I've been living).

items.bad: Yes, I like my hometown because it has many advantages. Firstly, it is beautiful.
items.good: Yes, I love it. I'm really attached to the lakes and the street food.
items.note: Từ nối kiểu bài luận (Firstly, In conclusion) nghe như học thuộc (handout, bài Revision).

items.html: It's famous for its street food. · It's best known for Hoan Kiem Lake. (Không dùng famous with, famous by.)
Với live, cả hai đều đúng: I've lived here since I was born. · I've been living here since I was born. Dạng tiếp diễn nhấn vào quá trình.

theory.tip: Nói to từng từ ba lần, rồi nói lại cả câu mẫu có chứa từ đó.

exercises.title: Bài tập 1: Từ vựng chủ đề → câu nói
exercises.intro: Nhìn gợi ý, nói to câu hoàn chỉnh (không đọc), rồi viết lại. Mỗi câu có một cụm từ vựng của chủ đề; hãy dùng đúng cụm đó.

items.cue: I / born and raised / Hanoi / busy urban area
items.answer: I was born and raised in Hanoi, a busy urban area in the north.
items.alt: Actually, I was born and raised in Hanoi, which is a really busy urban area.
items.note: be born and raised in; cụm a busy urban area giải thích thêm về Hà Nội.

items.cue: public transport / in Hanoi / get / more modern
items.hint: Hiện tại tiếp diễn cho sự thay đổi
items.answer: Public transport in Hanoi is getting more modern.
items.alt: These days, public transport in Hanoi is getting more modern, especially the metro.
items.note: be getting + tính từ so sánh diễn tả sự thay đổi đang diễn ra.

items.cue: my grandparents / live / quiet rural area / outside the city
items.answer: My grandparents live in a quiet rural area outside the city.
items.alt: My grandparents still live in a quiet rural area just outside the city.
items.note: in a rural area (mạo từ a, giới từ in).

items.cue: I / proud of / local culture / here
items.answer: I'm proud of the local culture here.
items.alt: Honestly, I'm really proud of the local culture here.
items.note: be proud of + danh từ.

items.cue: Hanoi / famous for / cultural heritage / especially / old temples
items.answer: Hanoi is famous for its cultural heritage, especially its old temples.
items.alt: Hanoi is really famous for its cultural heritage, especially the old temples and pagodas.
items.note: famous for + danh từ; especially đưa ví dụ cụ thể.

items.cue: the city / undergo / rapid expansion | new districts / everywhere
items.answer: The city has undergone rapid expansion, and there are new districts everywhere.
items.alt: In recent years the city has undergone rapid expansion, with new districts everywhere.
items.note: undergo (bất quy tắc): undergo, underwent, undergone.

items.cue: in my alley / Mid-Autumn Festival / bring / lots of / social interaction
items.answer: In my alley, the Mid-Autumn Festival brings lots of social interaction between neighbours.
items.alt: The Mid-Autumn Festival brings lots of social interaction in my alley, because all the kids play together.
items.note: bring chia brings (chủ ngữ số ít).

items.cue: Say what the city's history is like. Use "historical background".
items.hint: Hai câu: nhận xét + chi tiết
items.answer: Hanoi has a really rich historical background. It was the capital under several dynasties, and it's over a thousand years old.
items.alt: The city has a fascinating historical background, since it's been the capital for centuries.
items.note: Nhận xét chung → chi tiết cụ thể (over a thousand years).

items.cue: Say how life in the city has changed. Use "living standards".
items.hint: Hiện tại hoàn thành + so sánh
items.answer: Living standards have improved a lot. When my parents were young, few families had a car, but now lots of people do.
items.alt: Living standards have gone up a lot. My parents grew up without a fridge, but now every home has one.
items.note: have improved / have gone up (hiện tại hoàn thành) + so sánh với thời bố mẹ.

items.cue: Describe the city's environment. Use "natural environment".
items.hint: Kỹ thuật 5W1H (What): nêu một vấn đề và một điểm tốt
items.answer: The natural environment could be better, mainly because of air pollution. Still, there are plenty of lakes, and they're lovely in the evening.
items.alt: To be honest, the natural environment isn't great because of the air pollution, but the lakes are still beautiful.
items.note: could be better là cách chê nhẹ nhàng, tự nhiên khi nói.

exercises.title: Bài tập 2: Mở rộng câu trả lời
exercises.intro: Câu trả lời ngắn chưa đủ ý. Nói lại câu ngắn, rồi mở rộng thêm 1-2 câu bằng gợi ý (mỗi dấu | là một câu mới hoặc một ý mới). Nói to trước, viết sau.

items.q: Is that a big city or a small place?
items.expand: capital city | over eight million people / live / there
items.answer: It's a really big city. It's the capital city, and over eight million people live there.
items.alt: It's a really big city. Over eight million people live there, and it's also the capital city.
items.note: Câu hỏi chọn lựa: chọn big city, rồi đưa một con số để chứng minh.

items.q: How long have you been living there?
items.expand: I've lived / since / I / be / born | never / live / anywhere else
items.hint: Kỹ thuật Tense control (hiện tại hoàn thành)
items.answer: My whole life. I've lived here since I was born, and I've never lived anywhere else.
items.alt: My whole life, actually. I've lived here since I was born and never lived anywhere else.
items.note: Câu hỏi How long have you been living…? → trả lời bằng I've lived / I've been living… since….

items.q: What's your hometown famous for?
items.expand: street food / especially / pho | also / known for / Hoan Kiem Lake
items.answer: It's famous for its food, especially street food like pho. It's also known for Hoan Kiem Lake, right in the centre.
items.alt: It's famous for its food, especially street food like pho. Hoan Kiem Lake is also well known, and lots of tourists go there.
items.note: Thêm 1-2 ví dụ cụ thể thay vì chỉ nói food.

items.q: Do you like your hometown?
items.expand: proud of / cultural heritage | all / my childhood memories / here
items.answer: Yes, I do. I'm proud of its cultural heritage, and all my childhood memories are here.
items.alt: Yes, I do, because I'm proud of its cultural heritage. Besides, all my childhood memories are here.
items.note: Lý do gắn với bạn (my childhood memories) tự nhiên hơn it has many advantages.

items.q: What do you like (most) about your hometown?
items.short: What I like most is the street food.
items.expand: food stall / on every corner | cheap / and / delicious
items.answer: What I like most is the street food. There's a food stall on every corner, and everything's cheap and delicious.
items.alt: What I like most is the street food. You can find a food stall on every corner, and it's cheap and delicious.
items.note: Câu chẻ What I like most is… + chi tiết cụ thể.

items.q: Is there anything you dislike about it?
items.expand: traffic jams / every day | air pollution / also / pretty bad / in winter
items.answer: Yes, the traffic. There are traffic jams every day, and the air pollution is also pretty bad in winter.
items.alt: Yes, the traffic. We get traffic jams every day, and in winter the air pollution is also pretty bad.
items.note: Hai vấn đề cụ thể, mỗi vấn đề có một chi tiết thời gian.

items.q: Are there many young people in your hometown?
items.expand: students / from / other provinces / come / study | city / feel / young / energetic
items.answer: Yes, loads. Lots of students from other provinces come here to study, so the city feels really young and energetic.
items.alt: Yes, loads, because students from other provinces come here to study. It makes the city feel young and energetic.
items.note: Giữ chủ đề young people (không chuyển sang I).

items.q: Did you learn about the culture of your hometown in your childhood?
items.expand: every Mid-Autumn Festival / grandparents / take / me / Hang Ma Street | local culture
items.hint: Kỹ thuật Tense control (quá khứ) + Personalisation
items.answer: Yes, I did. Every Mid-Autumn Festival, my grandparents took me to Hang Ma Street to see the lanterns. That's how I learned about the local culture.
items.alt: Yes, I did. My grandparents used to take me to Hang Ma Street every Mid-Autumn Festival, and that's how I got to know the local culture.
items.note: Câu hỏi quá khứ → took / used to take; kỷ niệm riêng làm câu trả lời thật.

items.q: Please describe your hometown a little.
items.short: Sure. It's the capital of Vietnam.
items.expand: in the north | mix of / old and new | narrow streets / Old Quarter / modern skyscrapers
items.answer: Sure. It's the capital of Vietnam, in the north. It's a mix of old and new, with narrow streets in the Old Quarter and modern skyscrapers in newer districts.
items.alt: Sure. It's the capital of Vietnam, in the north, and it's a real mix of old and new: narrow streets in the Old Quarter, modern skyscrapers elsewhere.
items.note: a mix of old and new + hai ví dụ đối lập.

items.q: Is your hometown a good place for young people to pursue their careers?
items.expand: job opportunities / especially / tech and finance | only problem / cost of living
items.answer: Yes, I'd say so. There are lots of job opportunities, especially in tech and finance. The only problem is the cost of living, which is pretty high.
items.alt: Yes, I'd say so, because there are lots of job opportunities, especially in tech and finance. The only problem is the cost of living.
items.note: Câu hỏi về young people: nói về cơ hội việc làm và một khó khăn thật.

exercises.title: Bài tập 3: Trả lời câu hỏi trong handout
exercises.intro: Trả lời bằng 2-4 câu (khoảng 20-40 từ). Số câu hỏi (Q) khớp với danh sách câu hỏi trong handout. Dùng cụm từ vựng cho sẵn và kỹ thuật ở dòng gợi ý. Câu mẫu trong đáp án chỉ để tham khảo; hãy nói về cuộc sống thật của bạn.

items.q: Have you learned anything about the history of your hometown?
items.hint: Kỹ thuật Tense control (hiện tại hoàn thành → quá khứ)
items.answer: Yes, I have. I've learned that the city has a rich historical background, and last year I visited the Temple of Literature, which is often called Vietnam's first university.

items.q: Do you like living there?
items.answer: Yes, I do. I've always lived in a busy urban area, so I'm used to the noise, and I love that there's always something going on.

items.q: Did you learn about the history of your hometown at school?
items.answer: Yes, we did. We learned that Hanoi used to be called Thang Long, and our class went on a field trip to see the city's cultural heritage at the Imperial Citadel.

items.q: Please describe your hometown a little.
items.answer: Sure. Hanoi is the capital of Vietnam, in the north. It's undergone rapid expansion recently, so you've got the old streets of the Old Quarter next to brand-new districts.

items.q: What's your hometown famous for?
items.answer: It's best known for its street food and its cultural heritage. Tourists love trying pho in the Old Quarter and visiting the old temples around Hoan Kiem Lake.

items.q: Is there anything you dislike about it?
items.answer: Mostly the traffic. Public transport is improving, but it still doesn't reach my area, so I spend about forty minutes a day stuck in traffic on my way to school.

items.q: Do you like your hometown?
items.answer: Yes, I really do. The local community in my alley is really close, so when I was little, all the neighbours treated me like their own kid.

items.q: Is your hometown a good place for young people to pursue their careers?
items.answer: Yes, I'd say so. Living standards are higher here than in most provinces, and there are lots of jobs in tech and finance. The only problem is that rent is quite expensive.

items.q: Are there many young people in your hometown?
items.answer: Yes, there are loads. Students from all over the country come here for university, so coffee shops are always full of social interaction, especially at weekends.

items.q: How long have you been living there?
items.hint: Kỹ thuật Tense control (hiện tại hoàn thành)
items.answer: I've been living here since I was born. My parents grew up in a rural area, though, so I've spent lots of summer holidays in the countryside too.
